verses: Where the hemp grows on the mound, There some one keeps Tsu-chieh; There some one keeps Tsu-chieh:— Why comes not he to me with a bound?
On the mound where grows the wheat, There some one keeps Tzu-kuo; There some one keeps Tzu-kuo:— Why comes not he with me here to eat?
On the mound plum trees have place. There some one keeps those youths; There some one keeps those youths:— O for their chiu-stones girdle to grace!
